content.text: 5hDon Van Natta Jr. and Jeff Passan18hBob Kendrick, as told to Buster OlneyplayMiller: 'Jeremiyah Love is the best football player in this class' (1:22)Matt Miller and Ben Solak discuss what makes Jeremiyah Love the best football player in the 2026 NFL draft class. (1:22)ESPN staffApr 10, 2026, 07:20 PM ETReactionsThe complete order for all seven rounds of the 2026 NFL draft is set. There are 257 picks this year, with the Raiders owning the No. 1 selection and the Broncos selecting at No. 257. Compensatory picks were announced on March 9, and in all, there are 33 comp picks in this draft.The draft will take place in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Round 1 will begin on April 23, Rounds 2 and 3 will be on April 24, and Rounds 4 through 7 will play out on April 25. The draft will be broadcast on ESPN, ABC and the ESPN App.Check out the entire order below.
